minor.issue: Still returns HTTP 502 'Commande validée mais email NON envoyé' because SENDGRID_API_KEY is invalid (declared mocked in review). Order state IS persisted (status=completed, download_token, download_expires_at). Out of scope.

ui_bugs.issue: On mobile (375x700) fresh page load, gallery tiles' finish loading (naturalWidth>0, complete=true) but the React `status` state can remain 'loading', leaving the at opacity-0 over the .protected-skeleton, so the user briefly (or persistently on a tight cache-hit race) sees only the skeleton. The 8 tiles in the mobile screenshot looked like dark skeletons even though the image data was already in memory. This is the onLoad-vs-mount race that the iteration 5 code review already flagged as a non-blocking improvement. Suggestion: in ProtectedImage useEffect, after setCurrentSrc, also check imgRef.current?.complete && naturalWidth>0 and immediately set status='loaded' to cover cache-hit / SSR-prefetch races. Also setting status='loaded' on onError would let the watermark cover the alt-text fallback.

action_items: Consider adding the cache-hit race mitigation in ProtectedImage.jsx (useEffect: if imgRef.current?.complete && naturalWidth>0 -> setStatus('loaded')) — affects perceived loading on mobile and on cached navigations. Non-blocking for the URL-prefix fix itself which is verified working.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py L1180-1210 _migrate_photo_urls: idempotent and well-scoped — only strips when followed by /api/files/ or /uploads/, so external image hosts are untouched. Good. Minor: also append current REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL host? Not needed today since the legacy data was Netlify-prefixed; current backend writes relative URLs.
server.py L301-310 _hydrate_photo: now a no-op (just normalises None to ''). Clean.
server.py L286-298 _absolute_url: kept for emails only (deprecated for photos) — correctly documented; PUBLIC_BASE_URL still used for /success links and similar.

ProtectedImage.jsx L62-73 handleError + retriedRef: retry-once with cache-buster is a solid mobile fix; falls back to premium placeholder. However setStatus('loaded') is NOT called on error, so watermark layer never overlays the placeholder — minor UX inconsistency but acceptable.

ProtectedImage.jsx L42-46 useEffect on src change: resets status to 'loading'; this is what causes the cache-hit race on mobile where the can already be in memory when React re-renders but onLoad doesn't refire. Adding an explicit complete+naturalWidth check in this effect would close the race.
Admin.jsx 3 ProtectedImage usages (L674, L766, L892) correctly use watermark={false} so admin previews are clean — verified visually (uploaded tile has no .watermark-layer).

The migration runs on every startup_event AFTER seed_photos and is idempotent — safe to leave in place. SendGrid 401 is expected (mocked). rca of the issue: Root cause was already correctly identified and fixed: backend's _hydrate_photo previously prefixed every photo.url with PUBLIC_BASE_URL (which is the FRONTEND Netlify host), so /api/files/... resolved against the wrong origin and 404'd. The new server.py keeps URLs relative; the frontend resolveImageUrl prefixes REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL (the Render backend). The startup migration also strips legacy Netlify prefixes from any existing photo.url documents. Verified by (1) fresh upload returning '/api/files/nophotopix/uploads/<uuid>.jpg', (2) live fetch of that URL via backend returning 200 image/jpeg, (3) end-to-end render in admin grid at the correct backend-prefixed URL, and (4) migration test inserting a Netlify-prefixed doc and observing it rewritten to relative form after backend restart.
